annotations.title: Classify a supply for South African VAT

description: Is a supply standard-rated, zero-rated or exempt under the South African VAT Act, and can the buyer claim the input VAT (s17(2): entertainment, club subscriptions, motor cars…)? Answers from a curated rules table with the VAT Act section for each rule, plus related official material from the GetLawED library. Says plainly when no rule matches.

description.description: What is being sold or bought, in plain words (e.g. "client lunch at a restaurant", "brown bread", "double cab bakkie")

include_library.description: Also search the GetLawED library for related official material (default true)

side.description: sale = output VAT treatment; purchase = can input VAT be claimed; both (default)
